backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ToolShare backend, defining types (UserProfile, ToolListing, RentalRequest, ChatMessage) and managing state for profiles, tools, rentals, and chats with access control and HTTP outcall support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (removing Google Maps API, building CustomMapView with OpenStreetMap tiles, replacing GoogleMapView with CustomMapView) to their relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of pages, components, hooks, and utilities in the ToolShare frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app with no external script dependencies, mounting the React app at the #root div.
frontend/README.md: Minimal README for the ToolShare frontend, identifying it as a community tool-sharing platform built on the Internet Computer with a Getting Started section.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (browse, listings, rentals, messaging, profile, community map) wrapped in a ThemeProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication, showing loading state during login and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Auth guard component that renders a login prompt card when the user is unauthenticated, otherwise renders its children.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Renders a community map panel card showing member locations via CustomMapView, with a selected member detail popup displaying avatar, name, location, and contact info.
frontend/src/components/community/Custom: A custom interactive map component built without external map libraries that renders OpenStreetMap tiles, supports pan/zoom/pinch gestures, auto-fits to member locations, and displays CustomMarker pins for each member.
Renders a teardrop-shaped SVG map pin with an avatar or initials for a community member, with distinct colors and a pulse animation for selected/current-user states.
frontend/src/components/community/SetCoo: A dialog form that collects a user's street address, city, and postal code, then saves the full address to their profile via mutation to place their pin on the community map.
frontend/src/components/landing/Floating: A canvas-based animation layer that renders floating 3D-style objects (orbs, rings, faceted shapes, tori) with parallax, drift, wobble, and pulse effects for the landing page background.
frontend/src/components/landing/Interact: A wrapper component that applies a 3D perspective tilt transform and dynamic shadow to its children based on mouse position, disabled for touch devices and reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/landing/LandingI: A simple accessible image wrapper component with lazy loading defaults and a console warning if alt text is missing.
A landing page section component that displays a two-column layout with marketing copy (savings stats, description) on the left and a hero illustration image on the right.
frontend/src/components/landing/Toolshed: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: A sticky top navigation header with the ToolShare logo, nav links (conditionally shown when authenticated), a login button, and a mobile hamburger sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: A layout wrapper component that composes AppHeader, a main content area, and AppFooter into a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageHeade: A reusable page header component rendering a title, optional subtitle, and optional action buttons in a flex row.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: A simple wrapper component that applies container padding styles to its children for consistent page layout.
frontend/src/components/listings/BrowseF: A filter bar component for the browse page with controls for search text, category, sort order, min/max price, and availability toggle.
frontend/src/components/listings/CameraC: A camera capture UI component that activates the device camera, displays a live video preview, and emits a captured photo as a data URL via a callback.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: A responsive grid component that renders a collection of ToolListing cards with photo, title, category badge, description, location, and availability overlay.
frontend/src/components/listings/OwnerAc: A dropdown menu component shown only to the listing owner, providing options to edit the listing or toggle its availability status.
frontend/src/components/listings/PhotoRe: A form field component for managing photo references that supports adding photos via URL input or camera capture, and displays them in a grid with removal capability.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Active: Displays the active conversation panel for a selected rental, showing tool details, rental dates, status badge, and the chat interface via RentalChatPanel.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Renders a scrollable list of rental conversations, each showing tool title, counterparty role/name, and status badge, with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/navigation/AppNa: A styled navigation link component wrapping TanStack Router's Link with active/inactive color classes.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: A dropdown menu component showing the authenticated user's avatar and providing navigation to their profile page or logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to create one by entering display name, contact info, location, and address.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalCh: A chat panel component for rental conversations that loads and displays messages, distinguishes own vs. others' messages, and supports sending new messages via Enter key or button.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalRe: A form component for submitting a tool rental request with start and end date inputs, validating dates and converting them to nanosecond timestamps before calling the rental mutation.
frontend/src/components/rentals/RentalSt: Renders action buttons (Approve/Decline, Cancel, Complete) for a rental based on the current status and whether the user is the owner or renter, with confirmation dialogs and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/states/EmptyStat: Displays a centered card with an icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an empty state.
frontend/src/components/states/ErrorStat: Displays a destructive-styled card with an alert icon, title, description, and optional action button to represent an error state.
frontend/src/components/states/LoadingSt: Renders a centered spinner with an optional message to indicate a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTiles.ts: Calculates the set of OpenStreetMap tile URLs and pixel positions needed to fill a viewport given a center coordinate and zoom level, plus utility functions for coordinate conversions.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapTransform.ts: Manages map pan and zoom state with pointer drag, pinch-to-zoom, and scroll-wheel interactions, including zoom-to-cursor behavior and pan clamping.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts: Provides simple map zoom state management with zoomIn, zoomOut, reset, and wheel event handler, without pan support.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallaxMotion.ts: Tracks mouse position and scroll offset to produce parallax motion values, respecting the user's reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Returns a boolean indicating whether the user has requested reduced motion via the OS/browser media query, updating reactively on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, tool listings, rental requests, chat messages, and community map profiles. Wraps queries and mutations with cache invalidation logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useWebGLSupport.ts: Custom hook that detects WebGL support by attempting to create a canvas context, returning isSupported, isChecking, and error state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark color themes using OKLCH values, and adds utility classes for 3D transforms and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseListingsPage.ts: Page component for browsing tool listings with filter controls for search text, category, price range, availability, and sort order, rendering results in a grid or loading state.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityMapPage.tsx: Page that displays a map of community members with coordinates, allows authenticated users to add their address, and shows a member list alongside an interactive map panel.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with a hero section, how-it-works steps, feature cards, and calls-to-action for browsing tools or listing equipment, including animated 3D floating objects and illustration blocks.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single tool listing showing photos, category, condition, pricing, and location, with conditional rental request form for non-owners and owner action controls.
frontend/src/pages/ListingFormPage.tsx: A form page for creating or editing a tool listing, supporting fields like title, category, condition, price, location, and photos, with validation and submission via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/pages/MessagingPage.tsx: Displays a messaging interface showing conversations tied to the user's rentals, with a conversations list and an active conversation panel side by side.
frontend/src/pages/MyRentalsPage.tsx: Shows all rental requests and bookings made by the current user as cards with status badges, action buttons, and links to rental/tool detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/MyToolsPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's tool listings with alerts for pending rental requests and active rentals, plus a button to add new listings.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user's profile with view and edit modes, allowing updates to display name, contact info, location, profile picture, and address via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/RentalDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific rental including tool details, dates, cost, status badge, status action buttons, and an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/RequestsPage.tsx: Displays incoming rental requests for the authenticated user's tools, showing each rental as a card with status badge, dates, and action buttons.
frontend/src/utils/fileToDataUrl.ts: Exports a single async utility function that converts a File object to a base64 data URL string using FileReader.
frontend/src/utils/geoProjection.ts: Provides utilities for equirectangular projection: validates geographic coordinates, converts lat/lon to screen percentage positions, and parses coordinate strings.
frontend/src/utils/globeProjection.ts: Provides Three.js-based utilities for converting lat/lon coordinates to 3D sphere surface vectors, plus coordinate validation and parsing helpers.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalDateFor: Exports date formatting functions for rental timestamps (bigint nanoseconds), including short date, long date, chat timestamp, and rental duration in days.
frontend/src/utils/rentals/rentalStatusP: Defines color and label mappings for all RentalStatus enum values, and exports helper functions to retrieve them.
frontend/src/utils/timeOnApp.ts: Exports two functions that format a bigint join timestamp into a human-readable time-on-app duration string and a formatted join date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers for sensitive parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including accordion and floating effects.
project_state.json: Tracks project state and feature history, noting that Google Maps integration was removed and replaced with a custom OpenStreetMap-based interactive map component.
